remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Paul Rosenfeld's apartment, Feb. 11, 1946....No signature. Two green avocado pears –– green background. Mr. Rosenfeld thinks about 1920 or 1921. Title given by Rosenfeld. Bought from Miss O'Keeffe. Owned Paul Rosenfeld painting an sold by them to Mr. Goldsmith. I don't remember the frame when I first saw it at Rosenfeld's apt. in 1946, but the difference in measurements may be due to reframing. It is a very handsome picture. Two large green avocado pears lying on folds of green drapery." Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 26. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Small vertical canvas of two very green pears, placed in a bed of green folds.  This artwork has *Untitled (Lake George Landscape)*, ca. 1920 (cat. no. 332) on the back.
